pages.text: Sword Smiths do not spawn naturally.$(br2)Place a Coolant Block near a villager to give them the Sword Smith profession.$(br2)Despite being called a Sword Smith, they are surprisingly stingy and sell things for very high prices.

pages.title: What do Sword Smiths sell
pages.text: Sword Smiths sell many things.$(br2)You can trade various supplies from Sword Smiths, though some things are outrageously expensive.
